Regional-bank momentum could reverse because of credit-quality, deposit, regulation, or commercial-real-estate concerns.
China's recent rebound could fail because its prior 16-session active return remained negative.
A renewed mega-cap growth rally could cause equal-weight equities to lag SPY.
